name: Twilight Zone
source:
Twilight Zone is a text adventure game with graphics. The protagonist is a young man who finds himself in a mysterious mansion created by an equally mysterious old woman. His goal is to escape the mansion and have sex with as many young women living there as possible. The interaction with the game is performed by inputting text commands (Japanese kana only). Navigation is performed by typing the Japanese words for the four directions, and locations are represented as still first-person screens. The game has no real puzzles and very limited item usage.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc88/twilight-zone_]mobygames[/url]]
translation:
《暮光地帶》是一款附有圖像的文字冒險遊戲。主角是個年輕男子，被困在神秘老婦創造的詭異宅邸中。他的目標是逃離宅邸，並儘可能與住在其中的年輕女性發生性關係。

玩家透過輸入文字指令與遊戲互動，且只能使用日語假名。移動時要輸入表示四個方向的日語詞語，各地點則以第一人稱靜態畫面呈現。遊戲沒有真正意義上的謎題，道具用途也十分有限。

［引自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc88/twilight-zone_]mobygames[/url]］
